caption:
Desi Tomato Soup with Grilled Cheese 
soup recipe | easy | one pot | cozy sunday dinner | comfort food | vegetarian 

When the weather gets cold outside, there’s nothing quite like a warm and comforting bowl of tomato soup. And what better way to enjoy it than with a grilled cheese sandwich? The combination of the creamy, cheesy soup and the crispy, buttery bread is just perfect.

Nutrition: 
C: 31 | F: 5 | P: 7
Calories: 189 per serving for the soup 
Makes 2 large cups

Ingredients
1 tsp oil
7 cloves garlic
1 onion, sliced
4 tomatoes, quartered ( around 1/2 kg tomatoes )
1/2 capsicum, sliced
1 small carrot, cubed 
1 - 2 green chillies, depending on your spice level 
handful of coriander with stems 
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper 
1 tbsp tomato ketchup, optional 
1 tbsp cream, optional 

Method 
in a pressure cooker, add oil + garlic + chilli + onions, cook till onions are translucent 
add in carrot + capsicum + tomatoes along with coriander and saute for a few minutes 
add in water and pressure cook for 2 whistles
allow the pressure cooker to release, the mix to cool down ( if you blend when hot it will splatter and could burn you, not worth the risk )  and then blend the mix up 
add it back to the pan then add in the red chilli powder, salt, pepper and ketchup ( if using)  and bring to a simmer
prepare the grilled cheese as you would, its pretty standard, bread, cheese, butter, pan, grilled ready :) 
serve together and get dipping
